root_cause.text: The regmap_config.max_register field was set to the size of the register memory region (65536) instead of the offset of the last register (65532), causing regmap to attempt out-of-bounds reads beyond the mapped memory region and triggering a kernel page fault when accessed via debugfs.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "The max_register field is assigned the size of the register memory region instead of the offset of the last register." The patch defines `XDMA_MAX_REG_OFFSET` as `(XDMA_REG_SPACE_LEN - 4)` and changes `max_register` from `XDMA_REG_SPACE_LEN` to `XDMA_MAX_REG_OFFSET`. The crash stack trace shows a page fault during `regmap_read_debugfs`, confirming an invalid memory access from an oversized `max_register` value.
